<?php
class ObjectReturnGet {
    public function __get($incoming): object {
        global $payload;
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "bad") { return 1; }
        return $payload;
    }
}
$payload = new stdClass;
$receiver = new ObjectReturnGet;
echo $receiver->good === $payload ? "OBJECT;" : "BAD;";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $receiver->bad === null; }
catch (TypeError $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(), ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class SelfObjectGet {
    public function __get(string $incoming): object {
        global $receiver;
        echo "GET;";
        $receiver = null;
        return $this;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$receiver = new SelfObjectGet;
echo $receiver->same === (function () { echo "RHS;"; return null; })() ? "BAD;" : "OBJECT;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class GetObjectPayload {
    public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; }
}
class DistinctObjectGet {
    public function __get(string $incoming): mixed {
        global $receiver;
        echo "GET;";
        $receiver = null;
        return new GetObjectPayload;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$receiver = new DistinctObjectGet;
echo $receiver->item === (function () { echo "RHS;"; return null; })() ? "BAD;" : "OBJECT;";
echo "DONE;";
